mass_comparison_scope: same 2.000 kg total mass; removed sensor mass added to chassis for A/B; CG/inertia distribution is not identical; recording camera adds 0.000001 kg
validation_scope: requested progress and stop; speed-profile limit is not a verified target speed
collision_scope: active and stopping pose samples against static wall footprints; not continuous collision proof or moving traffic

actuation_diagnostics.scope: pre-shutdown fault diagnostics; no message alone does not prove no delay

rgb.scope: validator receive stamps, not detector callback rate or wall-clock FPS

imu.scope: validator receive stamps, not detector callback rate or wall-clock FPS

tracking_metrics.steering_measurement: 약 5 Hz 자율주행 상태 메시지 표본; 원시 조향 명령 아님

corner_speed_metrics.definition: evaluation only: speed > 0.3 m/s and abs(truth yaw rate / forward speed) >= 0.5 /m

motion_status_audit.scope: published status samples, not every control cycle

video.timing_scope: 20 fps of captured simulation frames, not wall-clock real-time performance

drive_delivery.scope: validator received /drive stamps; not internal timer execution count
